description: World Bank indicator values for one country by year, e.g. GDP in current US dollars (NY.GDP.MKTP.CD), from the World Bank open data API. country.description: ISO 2 or 3 letter country code, e.g. US, DEU, BR

indicator.description: World Bank indicator code, e.g. NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, SP.POP.TOTL

years.description: How many most recent years, 1 to 30 (default 5)
